thread:
acme-admin: @marta_cs hey — heads up, we cancelled our paid plan yesterday to test a different billing flow and reactivated an hour later. our trial credits (the free 1k) are now gone. mid-POC, can you help?

marta_cs: sorry to hear that — can you share the org id and the exact times you cancelled/reactivated? also any invoice ids you see under Billing -> Payments?

acme-admin: org id ACME-42, cancelled at 2025-09-01T14:03Z, reactivated 2025-09-01T15:05Z. no invoices charged. I attached screenshots in the ticket but here's the error we saw when calling embed endpoint: `error: insufficient_credits` even though quota showed 1000 until yesterday.

alex_support: thanks — quick note on policy: trial grants are normally applied at account creation and can be revoked if an account is deleted or fully cancelled. short cancellations that trigger a state transition can sometimes unset trial metadata. we can escalate for a manual reinstatement if account history looks clean.

sam_billing: I pulled audit logs for ACME-42 — there was a plan cancellation event at 2025-09-01T14:03Z and a plan activation at 2025-09-01T15:05Z. No successful payment events in between. Policy: auto-grant reversal happens on full-cancel + org-merge in some edge flows, but this looks like a short cancel/reactivate. I'll clear with finance for a manual grant.

lee_ops: @sam_billing can you paste the grant command if finance approves? I'll run it in staging first then prod. we have this helper: ```/internal/grant_credits --org ACME-42 --amount 1000 --reason trial_reinstate --by support``` but note we require a ticket id and approval.

marta_cs: creating internal escalation: TKT-5891. tagging @sam_billing and @lee_ops. customer needs credits back ASAP — they're load-testing embeddings this afternoon.

deploy-bot: [auto] Created escalation TKT-5891 and assigned to billing-team. Approval required: finance@redwood.

sam_billing: finance approved manual reinstatement (email thread). scheduling grant — I'll run the command now in prod with audit note.

lee_ops: running grant command in prod: `grant_credits org=ACME-42 amount=1000 note="trial_reinstate TKT-5891"` :white_check_mark: done. Please verify.

acme-admin: Confirmed — credits are back, token usage resumed, tests green. Huge thanks. Any note on avoiding this in future?

alex_support: follow-up: short-term workaround — avoid full cancellation flow during active evaluation. We're triaging a bug where the trial flag is cleared on quick cancel/reactivate; eng has a ticket to preserve trial metadata across simple reactivations. I'll link once created. :thumbsup:

marta_cs: closing loop here — TKT-5891 -> resolved, trial credits reinstated, engineering ticket ENG-3120 opened to fix flag persistence. If anything else, reopen the ticket or DM. :slightly_smiling_face:
